reason: C3 and A26 are designed and not built: protocol.md and renderer.md each gain a short section saying what the module will own of content classes and view policies, pointing at docs/content-classes.md, which holds the design so the hubs carry a paragraph each and not the design; revised after a review, the two sections say the per-instance decision, the one admission door, the capture check and the composed-class rule, and AGENTS.md's rule on view policies names the flags an agent never passes and the audit trail that stands for a wall; after the owner let agents choose a wider policy (2026-11-18), AGENTS.md's rule says the starter chooses among the operator's policies, on the record, and an agent never writes a policies file or changes a cap
